subject.title: refactor(channels): migrate googlechat, imessage, and whatsapp group policy onto the scope tree

question: Should the scope-tree resolver become a permanent public Plugin SDK contract before all bundled channel migrations are ready?
rationale: Code repair cannot decide whether maintainers accept a staged period with two public resolution models or require an atomic SDK migration.

options.title: Migrate Atomically
options.body: Keep the new API internal or combine the migration batches so all bundled callers move before the public contract lands.

options.title: Approve Staged SDK
options.body: Explicitly accept both public models temporarily and document the migration sequence, compatibility expectations, and old-path removal plan.

options.title: Pause The Stack
options.body: Hold this batch until the foundational resolver and remaining migrations form one reviewable landing unit.

recommendation.title: Migrate Atomically
recommendation.body: Keep the new API internal or combine the migration batches so all bundled callers move before the public contract lands.

likelyOwner.reason: This person owns the proposed design and stacked migration branches and is the best available routing candidate for the contract decision.
